Card Q&A.a: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.
Card Q&A.q: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, such attacks can be ended.  "End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?

Effect: ＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and the opponent blocks if able.)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an attack target is switched, you may end the attack.
